description: An oil painting of two tall-masted wooden sailing warships with dark sails, one lit with an orange glow, pitching on a rough sea under stormy clouds, with rocky cliffs at the edges. The smaller ship on the right flies a Union Jack. There is no border or frame, and the only mark is a small sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner.
